subject: Evidence triage for external security assessment - Acme Financial
messages:
From: Samuel Crawford <sam.crawford@acme.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial evidence request and scoping questions for external assessment

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Acme's compliance team is finalizing the scope for an external security assessment next month and they asked us to provide the following artifacts for the assessor:

- Latest penetration test report (or statement of not-applicable)
- Vulnerability scan outputs for the last 90 days
- Asset inventory that maps customer-facing endpoints and admin consoles
- List of remediation owners and current status for open findings

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide an unredacted pen test PDF and a package containing the scanner output? If we can't provide unredacted, we need to propose a sanitized alternative by EOD Wednesday. Attached is Acme's request form for reference (acme_request_20261009.pdf).

Also copying our assessor: Elise Martin from PentestCo (elise.martin@pentestco.com). She may follow up directly with technical requests.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — they have a review deadline of 2026-10-20.

Best,
Sam
Acme Financial — Security Programs
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Elise Martin <elise.martin@pentestco.com>, Samuel Crawford <sam.crawford@acme.com>
Date: 2026-10-10T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Initial evidence request and scoping questions for external assessment

Team — forwarding Acme's request. Action items:

1) Dev — can you confirm whether we have the full pen test PDF from our last vendor engagement (Q2 2026) and whether it contains customer-identifying info that would prevent full disclosure? If it exists, please drop a minimal evidence bundle (PDF + scanner output tar) to the Drive folder in the next 24 hours.

2) Priyom — please prepare a remediation owners matrix that maps open findings to engineering owners and current status. We should include ETA for fixes or mitigations.

3) Vivek — if any findings are still in-flight and cannot be shared, propose a redaction plan (what to redact, who signs off).

Lauren — please stand by to coordinate with CS if Acme needs additional attestation language or an NDA.

Deadline: internal draft for review by EOD Monday (2026-10-11).

Thanks,
Kimberly
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Elise Martin <elise.martin@pentestco.com>
Date: 2026-10-10T13:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Initial evidence request and scoping questions for external assessment

Kimberly —

I located the Q2 2026 engagement artifacts. The raw pen test PDF is available but includes attack traces with customer identifiers in two appendix screenshots (session tokens in logs). We should not send that raw. Proposed plan:

- Create a sanitized PDF (redwood_pen_test_summary_v2.pdf) that contains full findings and risk ratings but with appendix screenshots redacted.
- Assemble scanner output bundle (redwood_vuln_snapshot_20261010.tar.gz) that excludes any session-level logs.
- Put both into Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAcmeEvidence (link shared).

ETA: I can upload the sanitized PDF and scanner bundle by 2026-10-11 11:00 PDT.

If Acme insists on an unredacted original, we will need a signed NDA and a custodian-level access request — recommend escalating to legal.

Dev
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Samuel Crawford <sam.crawford@acme.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence triage for external security assessment - remediation owners matrix

Team — attaching the remediation matrix draft (remediation_matrix_20261012.xlsx). Summary below:

- 12 open findings from Q2 2026 pen-test: 3 high, 6 medium, 3 low.
- Owners assigned: auth-service (Vivek), infra (Dev), console-ui (Lauren).
- Highs: two are design issues (ETA for design review + mitigation: 2026-11-05), one is an exposed debug endpoint (patch scheduled 2026-10-18).

Action items:
- Vivek: confirm mitigation plan for the design issues (do we need a config change or code rewrite?).
- Dev: confirm patch rollout window for the debug endpoint and whether a hotfix can be prioritized to 2026-10-14.
- Lauren: prepare a one-paragraph attestation per finding for Acme summarizing status and expected ETA.

Priyom
Security Engineering Program Manager
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Samuel Crawford <sam.crawford@acme.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence triage for external security assessment - mitigation plan for high findings

Folks — quick update on the two design-level high findings:

- Finding A (session token reuse risk): mitigation requires an auth flow change. We have a scoped design already in the backlog; target for code changes is 2026-11-02, testing 2026-11-09. Short-term mitigation: rotate session tokens and add stricter expiry (config toggle) — can be done by 2026-10-18.

- Finding B (admin API exposure): we plan to gate the endpoint behind an internal-only ACL and add monitoring. Hotfix for ACLs can ship 2026-10-15.

I will add the exact PR links and test plans to the Drive folder today. If Acme wants assurance now, we can provide the short-term mitigation notes with the sanitized pen-test PDF.

-Vivek
Engineering Manager, Auth Services
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Samuel Crawford <sam.crawford@acme.com>, Elise Martin <elise.martin@pentestco.com>

Date: 2026-10-12T17:44:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Evidence triage for external security assessment - Acme Financial

Sam / Elise —

Thanks for the patience. We have prepared a sanitized evidence bundle for the assessor and a remediation matrix for Acme's review. Items uploaded to the shared Drive folder:

- redwood_pen_test_summary_v2.pdf (sanitized pen-test findings; appendix screenshots redacted)
- redwood_vuln_snapshot_20261010.tar.gz (vuln scanner outputs, sanitized)
- remediation_matrix_20261012.xlsx (owner mapping and ETAs)
- pentestco_questionnaire_responses.pdf (answers to common assessor questions)

If the assessor requires access to the original unredacted artifacts, please have Acme send a signed NDA and access request to legal@redwood.ai — we will route that for an exception review.

Next steps:
- Kimberly / Security: confirm whether the sanitized bundle meets the assessor's needs.
- Acme: please confirm receipt and indicate if any further technical artifacts are required by 2026-10-15 to keep the review on schedule.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
